title.narrative: Assistance to undertake preparatory analysis work in order to inform the formulation of a new Danish global forest programme

description.narrative: The objective of the assignment is to assist GDK in the identification and scoping of opportunities for the Programme by providing adequate preparatory analysis for the subsequent identification of Programme approaches and partners. The identification should be evidence-based and provide a clear direction in terms of overall impact, objective and outcome of the intervention. The identification will lay the ground work for the formulation phase of the intervention.
